title: Backgammon View v1 Candidate, cleanup revision 1.2.2
description: Display roles and physical board layout only. Stable player identities remain player_0 and player_1.

bottom_home_board_side.description: The physical side containing the bottom player's own points 1 through 6.

cube_display_side.description: Presentation only. It never implies cube ownership.

view_origin.description: source means the source established the view; external means the view came from separately supplied evidence; generated_default means a renderer policy created it.

x-bms-invariants: bottom_home_board_side determines physical point placement, movement directions, and bear-off tray positions. These are not stored independently.
cube_display_side is presentation only and never implies ownership.
